title: Integrated SiGe Front Ends
summary: I bring on-chip antennas and low-noise electronics together in fabrication-aware silicon-germanium architectures for demanding millimeter- and submillimeter-wave systems.
problem: How can antennas and active electronics be integrated on chip without losing sight of fabrication and measurement constraints?
approach: I combine antenna and front-end design in silicon-germanium processes, turning electromagnetic models into layouts that account for process layers, feeds, active stages, and measurement. The goal is integrated hardware that remains practical to characterize at frequencies where packaging and interconnects affect RF performance.

title: Communications Hardware
summary: I design high-frequency hardware for space systems and emerging communication networks.
problem: Which RF technologies can translate into compact, robust communication systems?
approach: I apply RF methods to nanosatellite telemetry, satellite communications, and emerging networks. The work focuses on compact hardware, dual circular polarization, beamforming, and practical validation, within approved disclosure limits.

title: Antennas & Measurement
summary: I validate antennas, arrays, radiometers, and high-frequency hardware using probe stations, VNAs, frequency extenders, coplanar probes, antenna chambers, and near-field measurement systems.
problem: How can mmWave and sub-THz antenna concepts be reliably validated under demanding fabrication and measurement constraints?
approach: I combine simulation and prototypes with calibrated probe-station, near-field, and chamber measurements. VNAs, frequency extenders, and coplanar probes help assess impedance, radiation patterns, gain, polarization, and beam steering.
